in_marathi.name: Riju
in_marathi.long_meaning: Riju हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Riju is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ritambhara', which means 'bearing rain' or 'ripe'. It is also derived from the Sanskrit word 'Rik', which means 'juice' or 'ripe'. The name signifies gentleness, calmness, and peaceful nature.
